page: Microsoft Azure EC64es_v6 is a memory-optimized virtual machine belonging to the ECEV6 server family. Powered by an Intel processor with x86_64 architecture, this server features 64 dedicated vCPUs and 512.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU. The instance operates on the Microsoft Hyper-V hypervisor.

This server configuration does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external volumes, though the instance is designated as Premium Storage capable. There are no complimentary public IPv4 addresses included. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the dedicated CPU allocation and high memory density position this server for resource-intensive enterprise workloads that require significant RAM capacity relative to compute resources, without the overhead of local disk maintenance.

Given the 512.0 GB memory capacity and memory-optimized architecture, the EC64es_v6 is designed for memory-heavy workloads. Suitable use cases include large-scale databases, in-memory caching systems, enterprise resource planning applications, and large-scale data analytics operations that benefit from a high memory-to-vCPU ratio.
